name: What is a bathtub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathtub-to-shower conversion involves removing an existing bathtub and replacing it with a new shower unit. This can range from a simple replacement with a pre-fabricated shower pan and walls to a custom-designed, tiled walk-in shower. The primary goal is often to create a more accessible, modern, or space-efficient bathroom. Conversions may include updating plumbing, adding new fixtures like showerheads and grab bars, and improving ventilation. This process transforms a multi-purpose bathing area into a dedicated shower space, catering to specific user needs and aesthetic preferences.
